# plot_mesh { #mofography.visualize.plot_mesh }

`visualize.plot_mesh(mesh, stylize=False, **kwargs_plotly_mesh3d)`

It takes a trimesh object and returns a plotly mesh3d object.

## Parameters

| Name      | Type   | Description                                                                                  | Default    |
|-----------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| `mesh`    |        | a list of trimesh objects                                                                    | _required_ |
| `stylize` |        | If True, the mesh will be rendered with a nice lighting effect, defaults to False (optional) | `False`    |

## Returns

| Type   | Description          |
|--------|----------------------|
|        | A plotly mesh object |
